summary: Add initial .plate root config schema parser, validator, and precedence resolver (defaults < local for MVP). Introduces PlateConfig dataclass, load_plate_config(), validate, and save helpers in plate_core.plate_config. Real runtime tests added to test_epic89_plate_config.py. Foundation for extension merging, gh plate configure/init, and full Epic #126 methodology ownership.
migration_guidance: No migration required for this slice; .plate files are new opt-in artifacts.
